value.account:
WHAT I CHANGED
- New auditor orchestrator/workflow/resume_projection_integrity.py (audit_scope, ResumeScopePath, ResumeProjectionIntegrityError, diagnostic builder), with call_frame_retry_lineage.py (index_retry_lineage / next_unused_retry_frame_id), resume_slots.py + resume_loop_progress.py (WorkflowStateProjection.enumerate_resume_slots, resolve_resume_step_id, resolve_call_boundary, ResumeProjectionValidationError, for_each/repeat_until validation) and call_resume_selection.py (reached-call revalidation). CallBoundaryProjection gained import_alias (set in lowering).
- CLI resume: bundle load -> root checksum precheck -> audit_scope -> only then observability overrides, session/process metadata, executor. Failure exits 1, prints the reason, persists only status/error/updated_at via new StateManager.record_resume_projection_integrity_failure / record_workflow_checksum_mismatch (raw-JSON rewrite so unknown root fields survive). A failing session close cannot replace the diagnostic.
- WorkflowExecutor.execute(resume=True): structural root (state manager is not a call-frame manager) rechecks the checksum through StateManager.calculate_checksum (four reasons), then audit_scope, before the prologue; child executors skip it.
- CallExecutor.execute_call (resume): completed-frame id collision check first, then one resolve_call_boundary per reached identity, boundary alias selects the callee bundle, retry lineage picks the frame (no mapping-order scan any more), checksum + bound-input validation of the running member win, then failed predecessors (checksum, then recursive audit_scope in ordinal order), then the running member's audit_scope, all before _CallFrameStateManager/child executor. Projection failures come back as the caller's failed step result, unwrapped; a child's sticky error is promoted unchanged instead of call_failed. _is_workflow_lisp_target now uses provenance.frontend_kind.
- Sticky failure: _handle_control_flow returns _stop (also for for_each result lists); loops stop for_each without completing the iteration and keep the repeat_until frame error unchanged; the epilogue forces failed status and sets the run error; FinalizationController keeps a cleanup projection error unwrapped and makes ordinary cleanup failures supplemental (failure.error null) once a diagnostic is active.
- Observability: current_step_is_forensic() (state.py) makes build_status_snapshot report the step pending (not running/in progress), and heartbeat/stalled helpers (monitor messages, dashboard projection/cursor, state-only report) ignore it.
- Classic-YAML duplicate import alias / duplicate imports section checks (orchestrator/yaml_import_aliases.py, called from loader before bundle construction) and typed frontend_kind="workflow_lisp" on every compiler bundle (workflow_lisp/lowering/core.py, build.py no longer overwrites) were done by delegated sub-agents; I reviewed the diffs and tests. To keep the typed capability from changing resume policy for compile-only bundles, lexical_checkpoint_default_resume._is_workflow_lisp_route now needs a lowering schema as well as frontend_kind.
- Docs: specs/state.md section 'Checksum-Compatible Resume Projection Integrity', specs/acceptance/index.md items 201-211, capability matrix row.
- Tests: tests/test_resume_projection_integrity.py (auditor, slots, loop messages, lineage, envelopes, architecture independence), tests/test_resume_projection_integrity_runtime.py (reached-call ordering, collision, lineage with typed Workflow Lisp callee, unwrapped promotion, executor guard reasons, three-field delta, sticky routes/finalization, for_each stop, forensic observability, CLI session-close), plus the sub-agents' loader/provenance tests. Full suite: no new failures vs. a pristine HEAD export (47 pre-existing environment failures remain; one unrelated test is flaky under -n 16 and passes alone). A manual CLI run/resume smoke worked and a stale current_step.step_id exits 1 with only the envelope written.
- Existing tests rewritten because they encoded the old gap or lacked mandatory ids: the resume_command/subworkflow characterization tests (mutation order, ambiguity, stale caller, callee-local), seeds missing current_step.step_id, the lexical bookkeeping-drift test, the adjudication changed-config test (bypasses the new earlier checksum guard), and two wcc golden files (new import_alias field).

DECISIONS / ALTERNATIVES
- Repeat-until declared maximum: adding max_iterations as a dataclass field changed the projection golden snapshots, so it is attached as a non-field attribute (declared_max_iterations); the alternative of reading it from the persisted frame's debug echo was weaker and was dropped.
- The auditor uses the module-level resolve_call_boundary function, while reached calls use the projection method, so the method is called exactly once per reached identity.
- audit_scope returns without checking when the bundle has no projection (CLI tests pass dict doubles); production bundles always have one.
- Considered keeping frame_id_with_overrides' resume scan and ambiguity detection separately; discarded because it is exactly the mapping-order selection the task forbids.
- A missing loop-frame row next to terminal exhaustion progress is tolerated (restore/crash shape the planner re-enters); a present but contradictory row fails.
- Audit order is containers/loop bookkeeping, steps rows, current_step, call frames; the seeded multi-corruption fixtures therefore report unclaimed_explicit_step_row first.

NOT COVERED / RISKS
- repeat_until sticky promotion and the legacy (non-typed) loop body path have no end-to-end test; for_each and top-level routes do.
- Frame-level call_frames.<id>.current_step is not audited separately (only the callee state's current_step, which it mirrors).
- A completed root run skips the CLI audit (nothing executes); reasons beyond the twelve listed, field choices for lineage sub-failures and workflow_file values in diagnostics are my reading of the spec and may differ from other implementations.
- Nothing is committed.
value.summary: Resume now audits every persisted identity against the current projection before any mutation or effect (CLI, structural-root executor, reached calls), failing closed with one sticky resume_projection_integrity_error.
